label: Clay in topsoil, 0-30 cm (ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0)
native_resolution: 250 m SoilGrids, stored at ~1 km (0.009°) in data/raw/ss_clay_soilgrids_0_30.tif
notes: The county series soil_clay_0_30cm is the county mean of the same SoilGrids 0-30 cm clay at ~1 km (re-averaging this file reproduces it: r = 0.9998). Map: continuous colour from the 2nd (red) to the 98th (green) percentile; white = middle.
colormap: continuous red -> white -> green (red = low / decrease, white = middle / no change, green = high / increase); 2nd-98th percentile of all dates
smoothing: average of the grid cells in each display pixel
